# Compiler-owned host API surface

Owner digest: `41cfb98ccc9e116402a34b8de534300c4cecca689ddd8930fff8002a57d405ce`.

This is the completeness denominator for the handwritten CLI, embedding, and WASM contracts.

## CLI command forms

| Usage after `rad` |
|---|
| `<file.rad> [--no-check] [--experimental-laws] [--relation-schema <relations.rad> --relation-module <id> --experimental-relations] [--deny-warnings] [--strict-types] [--write-lock] [--profile-copies] [--serial-schedule] [--record <trace.radr>] [-- <program args>]` |
| `run [run options] [-- <program args>]   (entry from ./rad.toml)` |
| `relations check <file.rad> --experimental-relations [--module <id>]` |
| `new <name> [--template <template>]` |
| `snapshot [--update] [--create] [--experimental-laws] [dir]` |
| `play [--port <port>]` |
| `build --target <compiler-wasm&#124;browser-package> <input.rad> <output>` |
| `types <input.rad> <output.d.ts> [--feature <name>]` |
| `sandbox serve [host.rad] [--caps <caps.json>]` |
| `replay <trace.radr> [--to-frame <n>] [--serve] [--with <fixed.rad>] [--force]` |
| `fmt [--check] [file.rad...]` |
| `lint [--preset=strict] [file.rad...]` |
| `surface <file.rad> [--json]` |
| `effects <callable> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `writers <component&#124;resource> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `readers <component&#124;resource> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `path <from> -> <to> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `query-plan <view&#124;callable> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `cost-path <callable> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `why <entity> <component> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `why-field <entity> <component> <field> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `why-removed <entity> <component> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `why-not-in-view <view> <entity> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `bench <file.rad> [--json] [-- <program args>]` |
| `model-check <file.rad> [--model <name>] [--runs <n>] [--max-commands <n>] [--seed <n>] [--artifact-dir <dir>] [--json]` |
| `shrink <model-failure.radr>` |
| `ffi verify <plugin> [--contract <contract.json>] [--json]` |
| `test [dir]` |
| `lsp [--experimental-relations]` |
| `--version` |
| `--help` |
| `model-check <file.rad> [options]` |
| `path <from> -> <to> [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `{command} <name> [--json] [--file <file.rad>]` |
| `--help`.` |
